title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Entitlement Duration, Wage Cap Fractions and Benefit Year Length
content:
Entitlement on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is bounded by the program figures set out here: the maximum duration in weeks of the full weekly amount, the fraction of base-period wages that caps the maximum benefit amount, the fraction of the parent regular claim's maximum benefit amount that caps Extended Benefits entitlement, whether entitlement already payable on a parent claim is deducted, and the length of the benefit year or eligibility period measured from the claim effective date.

| Program | Maximum duration (weeks of the full weekly amount) | Base-period-wage fraction capping the maximum benefit amount | Fraction of the parent regular claim's maximum benefit amount that caps Extended Benefits entitlement | Parent entitlement deducted | Benefit year or eligibility period (weeks from the effective date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 26 | 0.3333 | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | No | 52 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 26 | 0.3333 | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | No | 52 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 26 | 0.3333 | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | No | 52 |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 26 | 0.3333 | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | No | 52 |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 13 | 0 (cap not used) | 0.5 | No | 52 |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 52 | 0 (cap not used) | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | Yes | 104 |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 26 | 0 (cap not used) | 0 (not an Extended Benefits claim) | No | 26 |

## Notes

- A base-period-wage fraction of 0 means the wage cap is not used by that program.
- A fraction of the parent regular claim's maximum benefit amount of 0 means the claim is not an Extended Benefits claim; the figure is 0.5 for the Extended Benefits (EB) program.
- "Parent entitlement deducted" states whether regular and Extended Benefits entitlement already payable on the parent claim is deducted from the program's entitlement; it applies to Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) only.
- The benefit year length is counted from the claim effective date, a Sunday.

### Hypothetical reading

On a hypothetical Regular State Unemployment Insurance claim with base-period wages of 30000.00, the wage cap is 0.3333 times 30000.00, that is 9999.00 before rounding; the table schedules the figure, and the rules that apply it are not part of this table.
